properties.title: Pacific administrative boundaries (long table)
properties.description: Concatenation of the per-country long tables (one row per unit per level), licence-restricted rows excluded. Built from 35 sources (listed in pab:source_ids, with citations in sci:citation) published by: US Census Bureau, Geography Division; Toitu Te Whenua Land Information New Zealand (LINZ); Pacific Community (SPC) Geoscience, Energy and Maritime Division (PCRAFI); source PopGIS / Cook Islands Statistics Office; Pacific Community (SPC) Statistics for Development Division / Cook Islands Statistics Office; SPC Statistics for Development Division (SDD) for Fiji Bureau of Statistics (Pacific Data Hub); SPC Statistics for Development Division (SDD) for FSM Division of Statistics; U.S. Census Bureau; OCHA Office of the Pacific Islands (HDX); SPC Statistics for Development Division (SDD) for Kiribati National Statistics Office; Flanders Marine Institute (VLIZ), Marine Regions; OCHA Regional Office for Asia and the Pacific (HDX); PacIOOS (data provider: U.S. Agency for International Development); Gouvernement de la Nouvelle-Caledonie (DINUM SGT), Georep; Gouvernement de la Nouvelle-Caledonie (DINUM - Service de la Geomatique et Teledetection; formerly DITTT), Georep; Ville de Noumea; Pacific Community (SPC) Statistics for Development Division / Niue Statistics Office; geoBoundaries (William & Mary geoLab); SPC Statistics for Development Division (SDD) for Nauru Bureau of Statistics; SPC Statistics for Development Division (SDD) for Palau Office of Planning and Statistics; Papua New Guinea National Statistics Office via OCHA ROAP (HDX); OCHA (HDX); source Papua New Guinea National Statistics Office; contributed by OCHA ROAP; Section Cadastre-Topographie de la Polynesie francaise (Direction des affaires foncieres, DAF); Institut de la statistique de la Polynesie francaise (ISPF); SPC Statistics for Development Division (SDD) for Solomon Islands National Statistics Office (Pacific Data Hub); Pacific Community (SPC), Geoscience, Energy and Maritime Division; SPC Statistics for Development Division (SDD) for Tonga Statistics Department; SPC Statistics for Development Division (SDD) for Tuvalu Central Statistics Division; SPC Statistics for Development Division (SDD) for Vanuatu Bureau of Statistics (Pacific Data Hub); SPC Statistics for Development Division (SDD) for Service territorial de la statistique et des etudes economiques (STSEE) / INSEE census; SPC Statistics for Development Division (SDD) for Samoa Bureau of Statistics. Licences (per row in the `license` column): CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0, Public domain (US Government work), CC-BY-4.0, CC-BY-3.0-IGO, PacIOOS data use (free redistribution, not for legal use), LO-2.0, Public domain, ODbL-1.0, CC-BY-SA-3.0. Some rows are used and redistributed by this project under a data-use agreement (CSDR-SPC data use agreement (user-confirmed 2026-11-20)); downstream users are bound by the row's public licence (e.g. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) unless they hold their own agreement. Full provenance and source notes: https://github.com/SustainableDevelopmentReform/pacific-administrative-boundaries/blob/v0.1.0/docs/sources.md#summary.
